description: Window controls (minimize/maximize/close/drag) and maximize state — custom window chrome, which only exists on platforms with a truly resizable window. macOS uses a native overlay (it does not draw the 3 buttons) but still depends on allow-is-maximized (onResized) and allow-start-dragging (drag region) — allow-is-focused stays in default.json because it is used outside the TitleBar (useWindowFocus, App.tsx). updater:default and process:allow-restart also live here (not in default.json) for the same reason: neither has a mobile target. allow-set-min-size is the onboarding's minimum window size, set and lifted at runtime.
